violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE HANDLING RAW MEAT AND MOVING TO SALAD STATION WITHOUT WASHING HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES AFTER HANDLING RAW MEATS. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW BEEF IN VALPRO 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. LEBANESE KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 07/20/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: COOK LINE EQUIPMENT, UNDER COUNTERS AND UNDER GRILLS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS UNDER COOK LINE EQUIPMENT, PREP STATIONS AND COUNTERS ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required: SODA DISPENSER NOZZLES WITH ACCUMULATION OF BLACK SUBSTANCES.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO CLEAN AND SANITIZE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOUL ODOR EMANATING FROM GREASE TRAP.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REQUEST CLEANING SERVICE AND FORWARD COMPLETED SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SHREDDED MOZZARELLA AT 56F, BEEF PATTY AT 54F, RAW BEEF AT 56F, RAW CHICKEN AT 61F IN VALPRO 2 DOOR PREP TOP; DICED TOMATOES AT 45F, BABA GANOUSH AT 48F, CHICK PEAS AT 47F IN BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR PREP TOP AND DICED TOMATOES AT 48F, SHREDDED MOZZARELLA AT 58F, PIZZA SAUCE AT 54F, COOKED CHICKEN AT 56F IN NORLAKE 2 DOOR PREP TOP (PIZZA STATION).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. DO NOT STORE FOODS IN UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CHICK PEAS AND LENTIL SOUP PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY WITHOUT DATE MARKING IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL PREPARED FOODS HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS ARE MARKED WITH DATE OF PREPARATION. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: VALPRO 2 DOOR PREP TOP, BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR PREP TOP AND NORLAKE 2 DOOR PREP TOP (PIZZA STATION)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE OBTAIN UNIT THERMOMETERS FOR REFRIGERATION UNITS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS OF OIL MIXES, SAUCES AND SPICES ON PREP WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED CARDBOARD AND ALUMINUM FOIL USED TO LINE UNDER COUNTERS IN FOOD PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EDUCATION PROVIDED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: VALPRO 2 DOOR PREP TOP AT 54F, BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR PREP TOP AT 45F AND NORLAKE 2 DOOR PREP TOP (PIZZA STATION) AT 47F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD OR TRANSFER FOODS OUT OF UNITS. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS in the KITCHEN PREP AREA, UNDER COUNTERS, DRY STORAGE SHELVING UNITS, REFRIGERATION UNITS AND COOK LINE ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. OBSERVED COVERED POT OF CHICK PEAS AT 50F COOKED THE DAY BEFORE IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION ON COOLING PARAMETERS AND METHODS PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED CHICK PEAS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE COOKED FOODS ARE TRANSFERRED TO SHALLOW PANS IN SMALLER PORTIONS TO ALLOW COOLING FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F IN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. DO NOT COVER FOODS UNTIL COOLED TO 41F.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED CHICK PEAS AT 50F COOKED THE DAY BEFORE IN COVERED STOCK POT IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION ON COOLING PARAMETERS AND METHODS PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED CHICK PEAS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE COOKED FOODS ARE TRANSFERRED TO SMALLER PORTIONS IN SHALLOW PANS TO COOL FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F IN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. DO NOT COVER FOODS UNTIL AT 41F. ICE BATHS OR ICE WANDS MAY ALSO BE USED TO ENSURE COOLING PARAMETERS ARE MET. ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE DOCUMENTATION WILL BE FORWARDED. LEBANESE KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 01/17/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED SEVERAL KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOP UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED KNIVES TO BE CLEANED.
